progs.name: side plate holes, stacked pair
progs.setup: Both blanks finished to 130 x 189, screwed back to back through the window area, clamped flat on a sacrificial plate; outer face of the LEFT plate up, front edge to +X

progs.name: side plate window and notch
progs.setup: One plate at a time on a sacrificial plate, outer face up, front edge to +X; rough out the notch and window with a saw first, 2 mm inside the lines

progs.name: side plate lift and spring pockets
progs.setup: Plate inner face up (same program for both: the pocket is on the centreline x 65), front edge to +X for the LEFT plate, to -X for the RIGHT plate; X0 Y0 at the lower-left corner as clamped

progs.name: fork plate
progs.setup: Blank 92 x 66 x 16 (edges and faces already milled), bottom face up for the holes, then top face up for the slot; slot open end toward -Y; rough the slot with a saw first

progs.name: head-top base plate
progs.setup: Blank finished to 115 x 107 x 12, front edge toward -Y, on a sacrificial plate; saw out the R47 cut-out and slot to 3 mm inside the line first

progs.name: cylinder mount plate
progs.setup: Blank finished to 100 x 100 x 12 on a sacrificial plate. Better: spot the L holes from the cylinder itself (see manual) and skip the L section

progs.name: roof block top face
progs.setup: Block finished to 60 x 42 x 19, top face up, 60 along X

progs.name: roof block side face
progs.part: Roof block, each 60 x 19 side face
progs.setup: Block on its side, one 60 x 19 face up, 60 along X, Y0 at the BOTTOM (wear-plate) face; run once for each side face

progs.name: roof wear plate
progs.part: Wear plate, O1 60 x 40 x 5 (annealed, before hardening)
progs.setup: Plate on parallels, top (non-rolling) face up, 60 along X

progs.name: thrust bar anvil face
progs.setup: Anvil face up, 42 along X

progs.name: thrust bar end
progs.part: Rear thrust bar, each 10 x 30 end
progs.setup: Bar on end in the vise, 30 along Y, 10 along X; run for each end

progs.name: bronze strip
progs.setup: Strip taped to a sacrificial plate, 40 along X

progs.name: stop block
progs.setup: Wedge face up, 42 along X

progs.name: stop block end
progs.part: Rear stop block, each 10 x 20 end
progs.setup: Block on end, 20 along Y, 10 along X; run for each end

progs.name: float lug bore
progs.part: Float lug, each, 40 x 24 x 20, top face
progs.setup: Top (40 x 24) face up, 40 along X, mounting face toward -Y (Y0 on the mounting face)

progs.name: float lug mounting holes
progs.setup: Mounting (40 x 20) face up, 40 along X

progs.name: roller cage
progs.setup: Brass blank 56 x 45 taped to a sacrificial plate; X0 Y0 at the lower-left of the 52 x 41 outline (blank overhangs 2 mm each side)

progs.name: wedge underside slope
progs.setup: Blank milled to 80.0 x 40.6 x 24.1 (top already flat), TOP face down on parallels, 80 along X with the THIN (leading) end at X0, 40.6 along Y; saw off the bulk first, 1.5 above the line
progs.z0: top of the blank as clamped (24.1 above the parallels)

progs.name: wedge trailing end hole
progs.setup: Wedge standing on its trailing end, 40.6 along X, as-milled TOP face toward +Y; X0 Y0 at the lower-left corner of the end face as seen from above (Y0 on the slope side)

progs.name: anvil top slope
progs.setup: Blank squared to 40.0 x 40.6 x 23.3, underside down, 40 along X with the THRUST (rear, tall) end at X0
progs.z0: top of the blank (23.3 above the parallels)

progs.name: anvil lift pin holes
progs.setup: Anvil on its side, a 40 x 23.3 side face up, thrust face at X0, as-milled underside at Y0; run for each side

tools.1: Spot drill 90 deg (6 mm or larger)
tools.2: 6 mm carbide end mill, 2 or 3 flute
tools.3: 10 mm carbide end mill, 2 or 3 flute
